description: Source code for STM32 SDMMC driver in Zephyr RTOS, handling SD card interface with optional DMA support, card detection, power management, and clock control.

methods.name: stm32_sdmmc_fc_enable

methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for SDMMC events.

methods.description: Callback invoked upon SD card reception completion.
